answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 12671 Country: Canada Title: In his house, did Rasulullah (SAW) walk barefoot or did he wear shoes? Question: In his house, did Rasulullah (SAW) walk barefoot or did he wear shoes? Answer ID: 12671 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 778/589=L/1430) It is mentioned in Hadith that the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) walked barefoot as well as in shoes. The Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) used to sometime ask his companions to walk barefoot: قال: کان رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم یأمرنا أن نحتفي أحیاناً (مشکاۃ 382 ( But, I could not find anywhere how the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) used to walk in his house. The common words of Hadith suggest that he might be walking in house in both the ways: کما في مسند الإمام أحمد في قصۃ طویلۃ: مشی حافیاً وناعلاً (مسند الإمام أحمد 7:127 ( Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
